scope: Finite user-declared route×state matrix and source quantity sensitivity, not a probabilistic/game state model.

reused_sources.facts: Fixed move geometry, base cost/use counts and documented resource quantities.
Per-move connected resident candidates, named exclusions, unknown fallback/order retained.
Explicit passive activation/end/exit phases, uncertain single-use budgets, FINAL conversion, M04 vs M07 distinct portal exception qualification.

new_declaration_rules: Each scenario independently supplies AP, inventory and passive snapshot; missing required field is rejected.
null is unknown snapshot and never an empty snapshot; [] is explicitly empty.
Missing planned mode instance produces exact per-route blocked/unknown state and missing step, without substitution or dropping the entire matrix.
Known prefix before a later missing instance retains its source subtotal and risk reference, but not a full route total.
All per-case raw inputs and qualified source/risk ledgers retained as sensitivity witnesses.
new_mathematical_rules: Maximum10 scenarios×20 plans of at most10 single-edge/item steps.
No probability or generated state from numeric intervals.
Quantity envelopes only when every explicitly supplied case closes that route quantity conditions; otherwise envelopeNone.
Conservative per-case named component rule compares same declared goal and terminal, closed quantities and matched risk policy.
Hope/shield grant quantities, baseXP, gold intervals and netAP remain independent axes; random-item value never ordered.
False conservative relation means rule not established, not actual route inferiority.
unknowns: Actual state eligibility/reachability, collision/order, current server and unlisted cases.
Complete reward totals/pools, random-item quality/value, actual final resources and actual safety.
Unknown snapshots, blocked/unknown movement tails and independent phase declarations.
Actual optimum, scenario probabilities and utility.
no_new_mechanism_lookup_reason: This group adds explicit-state bookkeeping and mathematical sensitivity over already pinned mechanisms; no new game numbers or script rules were introduced.
